items.summary: Recommendation: preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 as unattributed and continue matching-period reconciliation. Missing cost categories, budget ceilings, commitments, and learning thresholds mean margin, ROI, payback, and budget capacity are not calculable.

Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and create no new production, spending, monetization, telemetry, or requeue work this cycle. Amazon reports $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but it is aggregate under tracking_id 'other' and cannot support site-level revenue claims. Named site rows show clicks only and $0 attributed commission. AI spend is $916.91 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 39 instrumented sites, including $143.69 for 0daynews.com, $98.55 for americastrikes.com, and $66.06 for blackmarketapparel.com; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment, commitments, and budget ceilings are not provided. Therefore contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Continue only the existing matching-period revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation. Minimum evidence needed: provider-level revenue identifiers, complete matching-period cost ledger by site/fleet, budget ceilings and commitments, and an explicit learning threshold. Do not treat missing data as zero or use clicks, sessions, impressions, conversions, or AI calls as financial outcomes.

Reject unsupported revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecast, and causal-lift claims. The 30-day scorecard records only 3 proven outcomes, while 36 improvements await measurement and 9 implementation requests failed. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating indicators, not revenue evidence. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed until provider identifiers permit assignment. Continue existing reconciliation and report-only evidence work; retain all growth opportunities as deferred backlog.
